template.description: The operator's text (ADR-057): a template rendered once per step over config.* — the shared block the records follow (SPEC §10.3). The runner loads {file:} and renders before OPEN; the adapter receives text.

fields.description: Restrict what the model sees to these fields (default: everything known)

provides.description: The step's derived provides schema (ADR-033). Injected by the runner from the step-level provides: key — never authored inside with:.

of.description: The referent (ADR-048): the field whose value this step is about, presented to the model as the subject. Injected by the runner from the step-level of: key — never authored inside with:.

fence.description: ADR-035: wrap externally fetched fields in a delimiter labelled as subject-supplied data (default true); false opts out

deferred.description: ADR-038: submit the batch to the engine's batch surface (the Message Batches API, half price) and end the run in flight; the next `gtme run` of the pipeline collects. Valid only on the pipeline's last step.

fetched.description: The batch's externally fetched fields (ADR-035). Injected by the runner from provenance — never authored inside with:.
